# Shared skills — do not edit here

These `.claude/skills/` and `.claude/commands/` entries are **managed copies** synced
from Cenay's `claude-personal-toolkit`. They travel with this repo so every developer
gets the same `/wrap-up`, `/checkpoint`, `/init-project`, `/resume`, and `/next-step`
behaviour — including the doc timestamp standard (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM TZ`).

**Edit them in the toolkit, not here.** Local edits are overwritten on the next sync.
